sections.text_helper: Section 24.6.2 "OPAMP timer-controlled mode register (OPAMP_TCMR)" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 743.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x04
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 LOCK: OPAMP_TCMR register lock
This bit is write-once. It is set by software. It can only be cleared by a system reset.
This bit determines whether the OPAMP_TCMR register is read-write or read-only.
0: Read-write
1: Read-only (OPAMP_TCMR locked)
Bits 30:16 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 15:13 TIMPGA_SEL[2:0]: Timer toggle signal selection for programmable gain control
This bitfield is set and cleared by software. It selects the signal (coming from timer to OPAMP
multiplexers) that toggles the programmable gain control bitfields between the primary
(PGA_GAIN[4:0], signal at low level) and secondary (PGAS_GAIN[4:0], signal at high level).
000: None (gain permanently controlled through PGA_GAIN[4:0] and VM_SEL[1:0])
001: opamp_tp1
010: opamp_tp2
011: opamp_tp3
100: opamp_tp4
101: opamp_tp5
110: opamp_tp6
111: opamp_tp7
Bits 12:8 PGAS_GAIN[4:0]: Operational amplifier programmable gain and PGA flavor secondary control
This bitfield selects the programmable gain (bits [2:1]) and the PGA flavor ([bits 4:3]) when
the timer signal selected through TIMPGA_SEL[2:0] is high. Positive numbers represent
positive gain (noninverting PGA), negative numbers negative gain (inverting PGA).
00000: gain 2
00001: gain 4
00010: gain 8
00011: gain 16
01000: gain -1 / gain 2 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01001: gain -3 / gain 4 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01010: gain -7 / gain 8 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
01011: gain -15 / gain 16 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0
10000: gain 2 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10001: gain 4 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10010: gain 8 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
10011: gain 16 with filtering on OPAMP_VINM0
11000: gain -1 / gain 2 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11001: gain -3 / gain 4 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11010: gain -7 / gain 8 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
11011: gain -15 / gain of 16 with bias on OPAMP_VINM0 and filtering on OPAMP_VINM1
Other: Not used
Bits 7:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:3 TIMCM_SEL[2:0]: Timer toggle signal selection for operational amplifier input control
This bitfield is set and cleared by software. It selects the signal (coming from timer to OPAMP
multiplexers) that toggles the operational amplifier input configuration control bitfields
between the primary (VP_SEL[1:0] / VM_SEL, signal at low level) and secondary
(VPS_SEL[1:0] / VMS_SEL, signal at high level).
000: None (input configuration permanently controlled through VP_SEL[1:0] and VM_SEL)
001: opamp_tc1
010: opamp_tc2
011: opamp_tc3
100: opamp_tc4
101: opamp_tc5
110: opamp_tc6
111: opamp_tc7
Bits 2:1 VPS_SEL[1:0]: OPAMP noninverting input secondary selection.
This bitfield is set and cleared by software. It selects the signal to connect to the operational
amplifier noninverting input as long as the level of the timer signal selected through the
TIMCM_SEL[2:0] bitfield is high.
00: OPAMP_VINP0
01: OPAMP_VINP1
10: OPAMP_VINP2
11: OPAMP_VINP3 pin or DAC output channel
Refer to Section24.3: OPAMP implementation for OPAMP instance-dependent information.
Bit 0 VMS_SEL: OPAMP inverting input secondary selection
This bitfield is set and cleared by software. It selects the signal to connect to the operational
amplifier inverting input as long as the level of the timer signal selected through the
TIMCM_SEL[2:0] bitfield is high. The effect also depends on the VM_SEL[1:0] bitfield.
Condition: VM_SEL[1:0]=00 or 01
0: OPAMP_VINM0 (operation as stand-alone operational amplifier)
1: OPAMP_VINM1 (operation as stand-alone operational amplifier)
Condition: VM_SEL[1:0]=10 or 11
0: Internal resistor divider middle point (operation as PGA)
1: Operational amplifier output (operation as follower)
